title: Why Can't I A @google found poem #smallpoems #clmooc
summary: Why can't I sleep why can't I cry? why can't I pee why can't I concentrate Why can't I burp, sneeze, find a job, poop? Why can't I sleep at night Maybe I shouldn't ask all these questions
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Why can't I sleep
why can't I cry?
why can't I pee
why can't I concentrate
Why can't I burp, sneeze, find a job, poop?
Why can't I sleep at night

Maybe I shouldn't ask all these questions
